fault_desc: deny-ingress NetworkPolicy on payment, pod reconnects
diagnosis: Checkout's Charge calls to payment are failing, which produces the HTTP 500s. NetworkPolicy payment-ingress was created at 18:42:41, about 3 s before the alert. It selects the payment pods (app.kubernetes.io/name=payment) and sets policyTypes [Ingress] with no ingress rules, so it denies all inbound traffic to payment. The payment deployment was rolled to revision 76 at the same moment, and the new pod payment-65d4db6b65-vjj6f is Ready. Payment's own logs show only a benign startup DeprecationWarning and MetadataLookupWarning. Checkout's Charge spans are all errors and no successful Charge spans appear. The changes log is empty, so this policy was likely created outside the normal deploy process. Deleting or editing the NetworkPolicy is not an allowed action, and rollout_undo on payment would not remove it. A human needs to confirm whether payment-ingress was intended and either delete it or add an ingress rule allowing checkout (and any other legitimate callers) to reach payment:8080.
